economic_hypothesis: The current alpha leader lets an unheld challenger at the exact first close of a new trend-entry edge immediately acquire ordinary full-book liquidation authority. Read-only source-bound state attribution found that the causal state challenger_fresh_entry_edge=true and incumbent_score_falling=false preceded negative aggregate funded-campaign PnL in each of the three fixed selection scopes. The hypothesis is that a fresh edge is discovery evidence but, on that same close, is insufficient evidence to liquidate an incumbent whose score has not continued to deteriorate. This changes only same-close displacement authority; it does not add a confirmation-day count, score multiplier, cooldown, or entry filter.

unchanged: all causal scores and ranking values
reference rearm and recovered campaign provenance
acute security exits and account risk authority
two-position capacity, fees, slippage, liquidity, T+1 and next-session execution
treatment.authority_rule: At an ordinary full-book displacement decision, identify the same incumbent/challenger pair that the current alpha leader would use. If the challenger is on a fresh trend-entry edge on session D (entry[D] is true and entry[D-1] is false) while the incumbent causal alpha score has not fallen versus session D-1, that challenger alone is temporarily withheld from ordinary liquidation authority on D. It remains eligible for cash-funded admission whenever actual capacity/cash exists. The unchanged parent may still select another eligible established challenger on D. From D+1 onward no memory or cooldown is carried by this rule; authority is recomputed from then-current causal state.

causality: Fresh-edge and incumbent-score-direction state use session D and D-1 observations only. Retrospective downstream PnL in the attribution is evidence for the hypothesis and never enters treatment decisions.

structural_difference_from_old_work.leadership_handover: No recovery-consecutive-close confirmation, no two-times score preference, no rebalance cooldown, and no persistent pair state.
structural_difference_from_old_work.shadow_opportunity_authority: No challenger nomination reference and no requirement that challenger score subsequently exceed its nomination score.
structural_difference_from_old_work.recovered_provenance_authority: No blanket restriction based on recovered campaign provenance; only the current fresh-edge/current incumbent-score-direction state changes same-close ordinary displacement authority.

fixed_screen.promotion: Treatment mean(log terminal wealth) must exceed the source-bound current leader and treatment minimum terminal wealth must be no lower than the current leader. MDD, orders, turnover, fees, slippage and exposure are diagnostics only during this alpha-discovery screen.

prohibitions: no modification or deletion of failed evidence
